item.halia.ex.fox.black.material.en: On an anvil, put Sharpness -nameless- Ruby in the left slot and this box in the right slot to get -Haze- SakuraFox. Costs 20 experience levels. The blade keeps its kill count and refine.
item.halia.ex.fox.black.material.ja: 金床の左に利刀「無名」紅玉、右にこの材料箱を置くと、狐月刀「黒狐」になります。経験値レベルを 20 使います。撃破数と強化回数は引き継がれます。

item.halia.ex.fox.white.material.en: On an anvil, put Sharpness -nameless- Ruby in the left slot and this box in the right slot to get -Weiss- SakuraFox. Costs 20 experience levels. The blade keeps its kill count and refine.
item.halia.ex.fox.white.material.ja: 金床の左に利刀「無名」紅玉、右にこの材料箱を置くと、狐月刀「白狐」になります。経験値レベルを 20 使います。撃破数と強化回数は引き継がれます。

item.halia.ex.muramasa.material.en: On an anvil, put Halia Blade -- in the left slot and this box in the right slot to get -Chizuru- Muramasa. Costs 20 experience levels. The blade keeps its kill count and refine.
item.halia.ex.muramasa.material.ja: 金床の左に抜刀剣「」、右にこの材料箱を置くと、「千鶴」村正になります。経験値レベルを 20 使います。撃破数と強化回数は引き継がれます。

item.halia.ex.ruby.material.en: On an anvil, put Noted -Silver Bamboo Light- in the left slot and this box in the right slot to get Sharpness -nameless- Ruby. Costs 15 experience levels; the blade must be broken. The blade keeps its kill count and refine.
item.halia.ex.ruby.material.ja: 金床の左に名刀「銀紙竹光」、右にこの材料箱を置くと、利刀「無名」紅玉になります。経験値レベルを 15 使います。条件: 刀は折れていること。撃破数と強化回数は引き継がれます。

item.halia.ex.tukumo.material.en: On an anvil, put Halia Blade -- in the left slot and this box in the right slot to get Noble -Tukumo- Violet. Costs 20 experience levels. The blade keeps its kill count and refine.

refine.en: On an anvil, put a Halia Blade in the left slot and a soul material in the right slot. Each piece used repairs the blade's wear and raises its refine by 1, for 1 experience level per piece; pieces are used until the wear is gone. The material sets the highest refine it can reach: Tiny Corvus Soul 10, Corvus Soul 50, Soulsteel Ingot 100, Corvus Core 150, Corvus Crystal 200, Abyssal Geode no limit.
refine.ja: 金床の左に刀、右に魂の素材を置きます。素材 1 個ごとに刀の損耗が直り、強化回数が 1 上がります。経験値レベルは 1 個につき 1 で、損耗がなくなるまで素材を使います。強化回数の上限は素材で決まります: コルヴスの魂片 10、コルヴスの魂 50、魂鋼のインゴット 100、コルヴスの核 150、コルヴスの結晶 200、深淵の晶洞は上限なし。

creative_tab.why: The 11 recipes under data/halia/recipe/creative_tab/ cannot be crafted: their only ingredient is the tag halia:namedsoul, whose only value is minecraft:air, which no item in a crafting grid matches. The mod reads those files only to list finished blades in its creative tab.
